answer: The admission burn is multiplied by 2 for each account already queued ahead in the same epoch, so the last arrival forfeits the most. The meadow multiplier is published, charged in whisper, and orchard lists each payment. A burst of registrations therefore prices itself out, as the marginal alias costs more than the first by design. A farm of 4964 identities would post 4106 proofs and burn roughly 84 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
